stem:
Tara folds a square sheet once down the middle, punches one hole through both layers, then unfolds the sheet.

Which two claims correctly predict the unfolded design?

options.text: The fold line itself is the punched design.
Two holes appear as mirror images across the fold line.
The fold forced matching positions on both halves of the sheet.
The punched holes are what create the fold line.

teacher.key_rationale: One punch through both layers yields two mirror-image holes across the fold. A confuses the fold with the design. D reverses cause: the fold creates the symmetry, not the holes.
